packageRules.description: Inactive Vitest canary preparation: replace the false match only after the reviewed issue 37 E enforcement, isolation and native-runtime gates pass.
#255: update the russh SSH stack of packages/ssh-native together; russh-sftp tracks russh releases.

#255 (until the first release that contains @paratix/ssh-native, expected with C2 #257): require Dependency Dashboard approval for every Cargo and npm update under packages/ssh-native, keep such updates out of automerge, give their commits the hidden type build(deps) instead of fix(deps) and keep them on branches of their own (additionalBranchPrefix), so they do not share a branch, and with it the branch-level settings, with the same dependency of paratix or create-paratix. Vulnerability-alert PRs bypass dependencyDashboardApproval (Renovate forces its vulnerabilityAlerts defaults over packageRules; those set dependencyDashboardApproval to false but neither semanticCommitType nor automerge), so for them the hidden type and automerge=false still apply. This keeps such updates reviewable; it does not gate the first ssh-native release, because linked-versions puts @paratix/ssh-native into every release PR after B3, whatever commit triggers it. That gate is configure-trust.sh before merging the release PR. Remove this rule after that release so security updates trigger releases again as fix(deps).
